July, 2024
Author: Pankaj Bhatia

Bench: Pankaj Bhatia
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:47556
Court No. - 12
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 10921 of 2023
Applicant :- Kuldeep

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Civil Secrt. Lko.

And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Arunendra Nath Mishra,Abhinav Singh,Ramakar Shukla

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. No one appeared on behalf of the respondent no.2 despite service of notice.
3.

In terms of the F.I.R., it was alleged that on 4.5.2022, the applicant who is the son of the real brother of the victim enticed away her and took her on a motorcycle for eating chowmin and thereafter he took her to a jungle where he committed wrong on her.
Subsequently, the victim informed about the said incident to her mother.
The F.I.R. was lodged on 5.5.2022 and the incident was alleged to have occurred on 4.5.2022.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has argued that immediately upon lodging the F.I.R., the medical of the victim was done which do not indicate any injury whatsoever.
The opinion of the doctor was also written that on the basis of internal examination, no definite opinion about the sexual assault can be given.

In the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., the victim alleged that on 4.5.2022, the applicant had taken her on a bike for eating chowmin and took her to a jungle and there he committed wrong on her and Rs.10,000/- with the victim was also snatched.
She also stated that during the act, no pain was experienced as she had physical relations on various occasions with another person Babloo.
The statement of the victim was recorded and in her cross examination, she specifically stated that the applicant has no motorcycle with him.
She also denied that the applicant was the son of her real brother.

5. Learned counsel for the applicant has further argued that in the cross examination, the victim admitted that she had physical relations with the other person Babloo and upon her statement, co accused Babloo was enlarged on bail by a Co-ordinate Bench vide order dated 8.2.2023 whereas the applicant continues to languish in custody since 7.5.2022 having no criminal history, hence the applicant may be enlarged on bail.
6.
Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for bail.

7. Considering the inconsistencies in the cross examination of the victim, as extracted above,
coupled with the fact that the medical on record does not corroborate the allegation made in the F.I.R., the version of snatching of Rs.10,000/- is prima facie without any basis as no recovery was also effected from the applicant and the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is in custody since 7.5.2022, and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
8.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

9. Let the applicant Kuldeep be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.161 of 2022, under Sections 376(3) I.P.C. and Section 3/4(2) of the POCSO Act, Police Station Sandila, District Hardoi on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions :-
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
